question: Which of the following countries hosted the 2022 Asian Wresting Championships where Ravi Dahiya became the first Indian freestyle wrestler to win a hat-trick of gold medals?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **35th**** Asian Wrestling Championships 2022** was held in **Ulaanbaatar**, **Mongolia**.
 
• Indian wrestlers secured a total of **17 **medals, which includes **1** **Gold, 5 Silver, and 11 Bronze medals**.
 
• **Ravi Kumar Dahiya **is the only Gold medalist representing India, in the men’s **57kg **freestyle category, defeating Kazakhstan’s Rakhat Kalzhan on technical superiority
 
• Ravi Kumar evolved the **first Indian to win 3 Gold medals in Asian Wrestling Championships** which includes 2020 in New Delhi, India, 2021 in Almaty, Kazakhstan and 2022 in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia respectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Ravi Kumar Dahiya won the silver medal in 57kg men’s freestyle wrestling at the **Tokyo Olympics**.
 
• The **Asian Wrestling Championships 2023 will be held in Astana, Kazakhstan.**
 
• India will be hosting the Asian Wrestling Championships for the **9th time**.
 
• The **1st **edition of the Asian Wrestling Championship was held in 1979 in **Jalandhar, India**.
